# Feature Parity Registry
# Generated by Deep Audit — 2026-05-21
# Source: web/ React+Vite SPA (~5,400 LOC TSX/TS) + server/ Fastify (~6,700 LOC TS)
# Frontend entry: web/src/main.tsx → App.tsx / MirrorView.tsx (mobile detection branches to MobileShell.tsx)
# Backend entry: server/src/index.ts (registers ~17 route files)

## HOW TO USE
The macOS build agent MUST:
1. Before implementing any screen: search this file for all items where Screen = that screen
2. Implement every item for that screen — no exceptions
3. Change status from ❌ to ✅ when implemented, 🔄 if adapted for desktop
4. Do NOT mark a screen complete until every item for it is ✅ or 🔄

seeing the app surface. The fix is a follow-up run with an unlocked display.
